meta.name: exhaustive-crosscheck
meta.description: META-SKILL — mandatory entry point for EVERY non-trivial prompt. Decomposes prompt into 5 orthogonal cursors (Temporal, Source, Gesture, Topic, People), fires parallel Pieces LTM searches with pagination until confidence >= threshold, then orchestrates the full neuro (10 iter) -> code-hardener (5 iter) -> implementation -> lint-fixer (5 loop) chain. Self-evolutionary: after every run, analyzes outcomes and updates its own structure. Integrates, wraps, and supersedes neuro, code-hardener, and lint-fixer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂任务拆解为多轮并行搜索与质检，产出精修结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常处理多步骤复杂任务，需要自动完成多轮检查与优化
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle multi-step complex tasks and need automated multi-round checking and optimization

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把每个非琐碎请求当作复杂任务处理：先把提示拆成五个维度，检索长期记忆直到足够可信；再依次执行多轮分析、代码加固、实现和代码检查，并在每次运行后自动总结改进自身。
howto.when: 当收到任何非琐碎的请求（如代码修改、缺陷修复、新功能开发等）时，它会作为默认入口接管处理流程。

say.text: 用 exhaustive-crosscheck 帮我实现这个新功能。
say.note: 会执行完整处理链并自动进化。

say.text: 先做五维游标分解和长期记忆检索，再给出方案。
say.note: 它会先查历史记录再继续。

say.text: 用 exhaustive-crosscheck 修复这个 bug 并完成验证。
say.note: 会运行代码加固和 lint 检查。

howto.what_en: Claude treats every non-trivial prompt as a complex task: decomposes it into five cursors, searches long-term memory, then runs iterative analysis, code hardening, implementation, lint fixing, and self-improves after each run.
howto.when_en: It triggers as the default entry for every non-trivial prompt, such as code changes, bug fixes, or new features, taking over the whole workflow.

say_en.text: Use exhaustive-crosscheck to implement this new feature.
say_en.note: Runs the full chain and self-evolves.
